messages:
Maya Chen: FYI customer Orbit Labs (SG) is disputing an invoice — they asked for SGD & local VAT but got EUR. PO requirement is blocking payment: PO-5421. Ticket #12345. Can we reissue ASAP?
Raj Patel: Which legal entity charged them? is it the EU entity?
Maya Chen: Looks like invoice was generated under `redwood-eu` (billing_entity: eu-redwood-llc). Customer insists invoices for their APAC operations must be in SGD to match their AP automation. They got amounts that don't match their FX rounding rules. Example from invoice: 
```
Invoice 2026-03-04
Subtotal: EUR 1,234.56
VAT (7%): EUR 86.42
Total: EUR 1,320.98
```
Customer expected SGD 1,877.20 (they supplied their FX rate and rounding to 2 decimals).
Leo Martinez: Also seeing a payment attempt fail — payment gateway returned `card_declined` on first attempt and `processing_error` on retry. Are these separate issues?
Maya Chen: Card decline was for the original EUR invoice. They then asked for a local-currency invoice and attempted to pay but accounting won't accept EUR. So main blocker: we need SGD invoice with PO on it.
Ava Gomez: Steps I recommend: 1) confirm customer's legal entity mapping to `redwood-apac` 2) generate a reissued invoice in SGD with PO-5421 included in `metadata.po_number` 3) validate VAT treatment (reverse charge vs local VAT) using their TAX ID before sending 4) create credit note for the original EUR invoice.
Ava Gomez: API sketch for reissue (internal use):
```
POST /v1/invoices/reissue
{
  "original_invoice_id": "inv_01G...",
  "billing_entity": "redwood-apac",
  "currency": "SGD",
  "po_number": "PO-5421",
  "customer_tax_id": "<customer_tax_id>",
  "line_items": [...]
}
```
Raj Patel: If we switch billing_entity to `redwood-apac` will VAT logic automatically apply local 7%? Finance Ops?
Finance Ops: @Raj Patel it depends — our system uses `billing_entity` + `customer_tax_id` to determine tax. For SG entities we typically apply local GST (7% until 2025?), but we need the customer's tax classification. Send TAX ID and whether they're business or consumer.
Maya Chen: Customer provided TAX ID in ticket: SG12345678B and confirms B2B.
Finance Ops: OK — we can reissue from `redwood-apac` in SGD with 7% local GST. We'll also create a credit note for the EUR invoice. ETA: I can start today, can someone confirm the invoice line items (quantities/prices) exactly as they should appear in SGD?
Maya Chen: Same unit prices but converted using customer's provided FX rate 1 EUR = 1.4215 SGD and round half up to 2 decimals. They want rounding rules explicitly shown on invoice.
Leo Martinez: Noted. Also, payment gateway: if we reissue in SGD, we should force a new payment attempt and not reuse old payment token — customer got `card_declined` earlier. Recommend email to customer to re-enter payment or provide an alternate card.
Maya Chen: I'll ask them to re-authorize after we send new invoice. Also cc'ing them on PO acceptance.
Ava Gomez: One more gotcha — our invoice renderer currently truncates `metadata.po_number` after 20 chars in PDF header. PO-5421 is short so fine, but logging this as a bug for longer POs. Filing ticket ENG-4872. :bug:
Finance Ops: Creating credit note now. Will tag new invoice with `reissued_for: inv_01G...` and `original_currency: EUR`. Billing Bot: Invoice reissue workflow started — ticket billing-9876.
Maya Chen: Thanks. Can someone confirm once credit note is posted so I can update the customer?
Finance Ops: Will post credit note and send confirmation here when done.
Billing Bot: Credit note cn_02H posted for inv_01G... status: pending-refund.
Maya Chen: Great — once refund clears, I'll ask customer to pay SGD invoice. Thanks all :raised_hands:
Raj Patel: Quick follow: do we need legal approval for reissuing under APAC entity?
Finance Ops: Not for this customer — standard reissue policy covers it when customer requests local currency. We just need internal audit log. We'll include the ticket link.
Maya Chen: Linking ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/12345 — keeping customer updated.
